`cocoapods-frameworks.sh` was generated by CocoaPods 1.16.2 for this
workspace's Runner target. It preserves the real install_framework,
install_dsym, repeated rsync calls, and signing routines so our integration
checks fail when function-boundary assumptions are wrong. It is a test fixture,
not an executed application build script.

The generator is CocoaPods' `lib/cocoapods/generator/embed_frameworks_script.rb`.
Its MIT license is reproduced in `COCOAPODS_LICENSE`. Regenerate the fixture
when intentionally supporting a changed CocoaPods script format, then rerun
`ruby scripts/macos/test/normalize_frameworks_test.rb`.
